name: WTE QOL Loot Toasts
author: Unvios
description: Streamlines post-battle flow with zero data edits: item drops appear as toasts (icon + localized name) at the bottom right (combat shrine bonus loot gets a gold frame and sinks to the bottom of the stack), and one summary toast on top shows the rolled die face, earned EXP and gold. Control returns instantly; battle start announcements ("A Rat appears!"), corpse texts and the "Victory!" window are skipped. Disabling the mod restores vanilla behavior.
